nodes.label: Contacts List View — CRM
nodes.description: Contacts page showing 10 contacts in a table with columns: Name (with avatar initials), Email, Phone, Status (badge: customer/prospect/cold), Last Contacted date. Each row has Edit and Delete buttons. Alert bar visible at top. +Add Contact button in topbar. Sample contacts from Meridian Labs, Stackline, Cobalt Systems, Fenix Analytics, Orbit Cloud domains.
